description: SoH = measured capacity / design capacity, graded only when the last Qmax update is at most fresh_cycles old; staler readings are not graded (BENCH_TEST).
accuracy_source: TI bq20z80 product page: 'Better than 1% Error Over Lifetime of the Battery'; TI SLUA364
fade_source: per-cycle SoH fade over 50-cycle windows in the training datasets, each dataset weighted equally
freshness_source: TI documents when a Qmax update can happen (two rested OCV readings, at least 37% passed charge; SLYT402, SLUA364) but gives no cycle age after which it is invalid. The limit is the largest staleness at which the 90th percentile of training-cell fade (centered 5-cycle median SoH, datasets weighted equally) stays within 1 point.
